speaker: hero
text: Bit, my plant is *dying*. And I water it every day!

speaker: bit
text: Every day? That might be the *problem*.

speaker: bit
text: Step one. Take a close photo of the *leaves*.

speaker: bit
text: Send it to an AI chat that reads *pictures*.

speaker: bit
text: Step two. Don't just ask what's wrong. Let it ask *you* first.

speaker: hero
text: Why does it need to ask *me*?

speaker: bit
text: Yellow leaves can mean too much water. Or too little *light*.

speaker: hero
text: Drainage hole? Like, a hole in the *pot*?

speaker: bit
text: Yes. No hole, water stays in. The roots *drown*.

speaker: bit
text: Step three. Change *one* thing. Then send a new photo in a week.

speaker: bit
text: It's a guess from a photo. So test one change at a *time*.

speaker: bit
text: Follow for one AI trick a day.
